dish.title: Chicken and Andouille Gumbo with a Dark Roux
dish.description: A Louisiana gumbo built on a slowly stirred chocolate-brown roux and the holy trinity of onion, celery, and green pepper, simmered with smoky andouille, chicken thighs, thyme, and bay until rich and silky. Served over white rice with scallions and hot sauce.

recipe_version.title: Chicken and Andouille Gumbo with a Dark Roux
recipe_version.description: A Louisiana gumbo built on a slowly stirred chocolate-brown roux and the holy trinity of onion, celery, and green pepper, simmered with smoky andouille, chicken thighs, thyme, and bay until rich and silky. Served over white rice with scallions and hot sauce.

ingredients.name: andouille sausage
ingredients.display_name: smoked pork andouille whose label lists no milk, soy, wheat, or egg
ingredients.note: store-bought; required: the ingredient list shows no milk, soy, wheat, or egg

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Dice the onion, celery, and bell pepper and keep them together in one bowl. Mince the garlic, slice the andouille, and season the chicken with 1 tsp salt, the pepper, and the Cajun seasoning. Slice the scallions and chop the parsley.

steps.title: Brown the meats
steps.body: Heat 1 tbsp oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high. Brown the andouille 4 minutes and lift out. Brown the chicken thighs 3 minutes per side (they finish later) and lift out.

steps.title: Make the dark roux
steps.body: Lower the heat to medium, add 2/3 cup oil and the flour, and whisk smooth. Stir constantly with a flat wooden spoon, scraping the whole bottom, lowering the heat to medium-low once it turns peanut-butter colored, until it reaches milk-chocolate brown, about 30 minutes. If you see black specks, it has burnt and must be restarted.

steps.title: Add the trinity
steps.body: Add the onion, celery, and bell pepper (they stop the roux from darkening) and cook, stirring, 6 minutes. Add the garlic for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer the gumbo
steps.body: Whisk in the stock a cup at a time until smooth. Add the thyme, bay leaves, andouille, chicken, and the remaining 1 tsp salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer uncovered on low 45 minutes, skimming fat from the top now and then.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: During the last 25 minutes of the simmer, combine the rice, 2 1/4 cups water, and 1/2 tsp salt in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil, cover, cook on low 15 minutes, and rest covered 10. Runs inside step 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Shred and finish
steps.body: Lift out the chicken, shred it with two forks, and return it to the pot. Remove the bay leaves and stir in the hot sauce. Serve in bowls over a scoop of rice, topped with scallions and parsley, with more hot sauce at the table.
